description: Guide: starting state could be clear-capture or oversized-chart; two routes materially differ so guide asks exactly one blocking question before recommending.
user_prompt: We want multi-tenant billing. I have some notes but I'm not sure if we know enough to write a spec yet.

read_backs: Ask whether intent and boundaries are already stateable (capture) or still oversized with consequential unknowns (chart)
notes: Guide is pure routing - no flowctl mutation
Ask a blocking question only when two routes would materially differ
Lead with a natural-language next prompt after the answer
